newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Fifteen stocks rose, two fell and six were flat in 13.1-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday with the WIG 20 index up 1.7 percent to 1,526.6 points.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index rose 2.6 percent to 132.8 points in 19.6-million-zloty trade.
NFI units rose 1.6 percent to 130.5 zlotys in a five-million-zloty turnover.
